Name: Prince Teddy the Kitten - Custom Cat NPC for Jas and Marnie
Author: sugarsbt
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#a64d79][font=Georgia][i]Welcome [/i][/font][font=Georgia][i]Prince Theodore the First of the Valley![/i][/font][/color][/size][/b][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][i]On a rainy day, Marnie and Jas discover a lone kitten outside...[/i][/left]
[left]Through 6 cutscenes, your farmer will be able to watch this kitten grow into a rambunctious cat with a cute and somewhat silly personality, and make some contributions that bring your farmer closer to the kitten and his foster family.[/left]
[left][b]The mod also includes:[/b][/left]
[left][list]
[*]Dialogues that develop according to his friendship level with your farmer[/*]
[*]He can also attend festivals and make comments about them[/*]
[*]Gift tastes with gift reactions[/*]
[*]Two sets of portraits that you can configure[/*]
[*]A cute area where his bed and food bowls are[/*]
[*]Korean translation [i][u]COMING SOON[/u][/i][/*]
[/list]He will not be available as an NPC from the very beginning! Ideally, you would add him from the beginning for Year 1 dialogue, but the fact that he appears later on allows Teddy to be added late and still have his storyline believable and smooth.[/left]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Based on a Real Floof[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[left]
Teddy is based on a real foster kitten I fostered in 2025. The project began after he was adopted, when I missed his silly personality and decided to create a mod for him! The mod expanded a lot from what I planned. 

[b]Kitty Tax[/b]
  [img width=96]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475601-364277040.png[/img][img width=126]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475601-1570970543.png[/img][img width=129]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475605-1615726696.png[/img][img width=234]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475605-116283518.png[/img][img width=133]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475609-578848640.png[/img][img width=129]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785527334-1929751597.png[/img]
[/left]
[center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Requirements[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Version 1.6.15+ (Latest)[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2+ (Latest)[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.9.0+ (Latest)[/*]
[/list]
[center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Installation[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Download the latest version of this mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip the file.[/*]
[*]Place the unzipped file in the Mod folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure you have all the required mods, and that everything is up to date![/*]
[*]Enjoy![/*]
[/list][center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Configs[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[left]The mod includes various configuration options you can configure with either the GMCM mod (Recommended) or editing config.json (Unrecommended).

[b]Portrait Versions - Little Guy OR Baby[/b][/left]
[img width=231]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785280988-1065448014.png[/img][img width=231]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785281027-454535181.png[/img]
*This will not affect the sprite.

[b]Party Hat - Party Hat WITH String, Party Hat WITHOUT String, OR No Party Hat[/b]
[left]
 [img width=156]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475439-1540307468.png[/img][img width=156]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475442-569007168.png[/img][img width=154]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475442-1133559749.png[/img][img width=155]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475439-1348121620.png[/img][img width=153]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39308/39308-1785475445-1907863660.png[/img]
*The images shown above are "Party Hat WITH String." Party Hat WITHOUT String will remove the white string, while leaving Jas's portrait unaffected. Turning this off can help compatibility with portrait mods.
*The party hats are a part of the 10 Hearts cutscene.

[b]Attend Festival - Yes/No[/b]
This config toggles the festival participation of Teddy on and off. Turning the festival participation off can be for compatibility.
[/left]
[center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Compatibility[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[b]Compatible Mods (Confirmed)[/b]
[list]
[*]Recolor mods[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Less Ugly Town Interiors (LUTI) - Thank you Midnight Voyager for the compatibility![/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*]Diverse Stardew Valley (Compatibility is coming soon on DSV's end! Minor sprite inconsistencies for Marnie in certain events for now.)[/*]
[/list][b]Incompatible Mods (Compatibility not supported)[/b]
[list]
[*]Mr. Ginger (Not game breaking, but may cause schedule and festival conflicts, as well as lore inconsistencies. Future compatibility is NOT planned.)[/*]
[/list][center][color=#a64d79][size=5][font=Georgia][b][i]Thank You[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew discord and SMC discord members for help and support![/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MidnightVoyager?gameId=1303]Midnight Voyager[/url] for LUTI Compatibility[/*]

[/list]
